messages:
nina: Kickoff for VelaPay POC. They need a short runplan to validate microburst recovery and a per-10k-token cost for the UI mix. Can ops + sec sync?

omar: Quick matrix: 1) Soak: 2.5k qps for 45m. 2) Burst: 12k qps for 12s x6 (30s spacing). 3) Failover: route 25% to smaller model during 2 bursts. Capture p50/p95/p99 token latency, enqueue wait, avg_batch, and errors.

trent: Ops notes: warm KV/cache 20m before bursts; continuous batching; max_batch_ms=12; pin shards for Dedicated. Tag runs `velapay-poc`. If queue wait >50ms, trigger route to fallback model.

nina: Minimal smoke commands (adapt to k6/wrk):
```
python infra/loadgen.py --mix "short:70,long:30" --prompt-len 35 --resp-len 55 --qps 2500 --duration 45m --tag velapay-poc
python infra/loadgen.py --burst-qps 12000 --burst-duration 12 --bursts 6 --warmup 20m --out results/burst.json
```

customer-rep: Question: we use thin-client prompts (~30 tokens) and occasional tool calls. Please include tool-call overhead and provide audit log extracts.

sec-bot: Sec questionnaire link: https://redwood-internal/sq/2345. POC requires IP allowlist and BYOK preferred. HSM optional. Audit logs per-run available.

omar: KMS note: per-request KMS adds ~6-10ms. For POC enable host-side derived-key caching (TTL 30s) to avoid per-request KMS latency; we'll document tradeoffs.

trent: Cost sketch (ballpark): hosted ~ $0.029 per 10k tokens for this bursty mix; Dedicated reserved ~ $0.015 per 10k tokens if baseline retained. Add burst-minute surcharge if many peak minutes expected. I'll produce an exact calc after final prompt distribution.

ops-bot: Reservation created dh-res-81234 for 2027-05-18T10:00Z, pool=dedicated-standard-6.

nina: Next steps: Trent to post detailed runbook + cost calc by Tue EOD. Omar to finalize warmup/key-cache config. Customer to confirm BYOK for POC. Smoke run scheduled Wed 10:00 UTC. Tag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
